text: RESULTS: MRI Brain findings show lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). T1/T2 images demonstrate multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Given the classic MRI findings of non-enhancing multifocal demyelinating lesions in the context of significant medical history, this confirms an opportunistic infection likely caused by HIV or immunosuppressive therapy. We need to immediately assess your immune status to determine the underlying cause.
